description: quotaLevel(used, hasReset): the single quota severity rule shared by chips, status text and bars on desktop, iOS and Android. used is a 0..1 ratio (null = no figure). pct = round(used * 100) (the percent the UI shows): pct >= 100 -> exhausted, pct >= 80 -> warning, else normal. No figure: exhausted when the window still has a reset time (Google omits a zero remaining fraction), else normal. Colors: normal = neutral text, warning = --warning (amber), exhausted = --danger (red); the percent and wording always stay visible.
